sources: Microsoft Support: 'Change the refresh rate on your monitor in Windows' (a higher refresh rate shows motion more smoothly, especially in games).

Microsoft Learn: 'EnumDisplaySettingsW' (modes the driver lists) and 'ChangeDisplaySettingsExW' (CDS_TEST, then CDS_UPDATEREGISTRY). Only a rate the driver lists for the current resolution and color depth is set; resetting sets the rate from before.
measuredOn: Microsoft Support: 'Change the refresh rate on your monitor in Windows' (higher rate = smoother motion). Changes something only when the display runs below its highest rate; the gaming check 'Refresh rate' shows both values.
